<translate>
'''Saiyans''' are a warrior race born for combat. Their innate ability to grow stronger after each battle makes them formidable opponents, and they can transform into Super Saiyans and beyond. In DragonMineZ a Saiyan who survives a lethal blow gets a '''Zenkai''' boost, uses its tail to become an '''Oozaru''', and climbs the longest form ladder of any race: three groups unlocked by the Super Forms skill (Oozaru, SS Grades and Super Saiyan), the legendary [[Special:MyLanguage/Mutant|Mutant]] line, the hidden '''False Super Saiyan''' and '''Super Saiyan God''', which only a [[Special:MyLanguage/Super Saiyan God Ritual|ritual]] can grant.
</translate>

<translate>
== Overview and strengths ==

* '''Zenkai.''' From level 100, a lethal blow from an enemy leaves you at 1 health instead, and you come back stronger, permanently up to three times.
* '''Limitless Power.''' Every full-strength Zenkai also raises your Power Release limit.
* '''Tail.''' Saiyans have a tail, which they need for the Oozaru and Golden Oozaru forms.
* '''Many forms.''' Eight levels of the Super Forms skill unlock forms across three groups (Oozaru, SS Grades and Super Saiyan), plus the Legendary line, a hidden rage form and Super Saiyan God, granted by a ritual.
* '''Play as yourself.''' The default body type uses your own Minecraft skin.
</translate>

</translate>

<translate>
Both parts work on their own; there is nothing to activate. The permanent Zenkai boosts and the Power Release bonus can be reset with the '''Reset Passive''' wish or <code>/dmzracial reset</code> (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Racial Skills#Resetting racial progress|Racial Skills]]), after which you can earn them again from zero.
</translate>

<translate>
All three Super Saiyan groups share the '''Super Forms''' skill, whose eight levels cost '''13,000 · 21,000 · 31,000 · 42,000 · 52,000 · 65,000 · 78,000 · 104,000''' TP. ''Level'' is the level that unlocks each form; level 8 unlocks both SSJ 4 forms. Each form after the first of its group also needs '''25% mastery''' on the previous one. One number in the ''STR / SKP / PWR'' column means the three stats share it. Multipliers are the defaults at 0% mastery and grow up to 1.5 times at 100% mastery. ''Ki drain'' is the base upkeep per tick; see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Energy consumption while transformed|energy consumption]].

* The two '''SSJ 4''' forms are the Saiyan top tier: the strongest Saiyan forms, but [[Special:MyLanguage/Ultimate|Ultimate]] never copies them.
* The bulkier forms slow you down and make each attack cost more stamina: Oozaru (×0.8 speed, ×1.2 stamina), Golden Oozaru (×0.85 speed, ×1.3 stamina), SSJ Grade 2 (×0.9 speed, ×1.3 stamina) and SSJ Grade 3 (×0.7 speed, ×3.5 stamina).
* The [[Special:MyLanguage/Mutant|Mutant]] group is the Saiyan Legendary line (the Legendary Super Saiyan forms). It can't be bought with TP by default: the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] grants its levels, and Mutants can borrow them (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Legendary forms|Legendary forms]]).
* '''False Super Saiyan''' can't be bought or selected; see [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan#False Super Saiyan|below]].
* '''Super Saiyan God''' can't be bought or selected either: a ritual grants it; see [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan#Super Saiyan God|below]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Tail and Oozaru ==
</translate>
<translate>
Saiyans are born with a '''tail'''. You need it for the '''Oozaru''' and '''Golden Oozaru''' forms, which turn you into a giant Great Ape. Oozaru is the first form of its group and costs no TP.

=== Becoming an Oozaru ===

Select Oozaru as your next form in the '''X''' menu while you are in base form. Then either:

* at night during a '''full moon''', stand under the open sky and look straight up at the moon, or
* look at a [[Special:MyLanguage/Fake Moon|Fake Moon]], the artificial moon created by the technique of the same name (taught by [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta|Vegeta]]; it triggers the Great Ape transformation for anyone with a tail).

The transformation then starts charging by itself.

=== Great Ape loadout ===

While you are in the Oozaru or Golden Oozaru form, your first three technique slots are replaced with [[Special:MyLanguage/Mouth Blast|Mouth Blast]], '''Oozaru Slam''' and [[Special:MyLanguage/Rage Scream|Rage Scream]] (they are added temporarily if you don't own them). Your normal slots come back when you leave the form. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques|Techniques]].

=== Managing your tail ===

* The '''Racial Skill''' entry of the '''X''' menu lets Saiyans hide or show their tail.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Dende|Dende]] at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]] offers '''Grow/Remove Tail''' to races with a Saiyan tail.
* <code>/dmztail grow</code> and <code>/dmztail cut</code> grow or cut your own tail; every player may use them on themselves by default (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Commands|Commands]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Permissions|Permissions]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== False Super Saiyan ==
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|falseSuperSaiyan}}
<translate>
A hidden Saiyan form that you '''can't buy or select''': it is triggered by rage.

* '''Who:''' Saiyans from '''level 100 to 199''' who are '''not''' a Mutant and have '''not unlocked any Super form''' yet.
* '''How:''' while you are in base form at '''25% health or less''', a red rage meter fills on its own (in about 10 seconds; landing and taking hits speeds it up). When it is full you transform automatically, at no Ki cost.
* '''Power:''' STR, SKP and PWR '''×1.45''', DEF '''×1.2875''', no Ki upkeep. You can't stack [[Special:MyLanguage/Kaioken|Kaioken]] on it, and you can't descend out of it.
* '''End:''' once you have transformed, only the meter matters; healing up doesn't end the form. The meter starts draining 2 seconds after the last hit and empties over about 12 seconds; the form ends when it is empty, or when you die.
</translate>

<translate>
== Super Saiyan God ==
</translate>
{{Main|Super Saiyan God Ritual}}
<translate>
A Saiyan form that only a ritual can grant. Five pure-hearted Saiyans (alignment 90 or more, or 10 or less) in SSJ or SSJ Mastered give their Ki to a sixth in SSJ Mastered with [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Transfer|Ki Transfer]]; after ten seconds of channelling, the receiver becomes a '''Super Saiyan God''' for '''5 minutes'''.

* '''Power:''' your strongest unlocked form, with each stat bonus raised by '''30%''' ('''45%''' for Mutants).
* '''Rules:''' it drains Ki and has no mastery, you can't descend out of it or stack a form on it, and players without god ki can't sense you.
* '''Cooldown:''' everyone who took part waits '''30 minutes''' before the next ritual.
</translate>

<translate>
== Appearance ==
</translate>
{{Main|Character Customization}}
<translate>
* '''Hair:''' yes. Saiyans can pick any hairstyle preset and design their own styles in the hair editor. The editor keeps five slots (Base, SSJ, SSJ2, SSJ3 and SSJ4): each form switches to the slot it uses, and the editor can generate the SSJ slots from your Base style.
* '''Tail:''' shaded like the hair; you can hide or show it from the '''X''' menu.
* '''Gender:''' yes. Male and female body types share the same grid, so picking a body type also picks your gender.
* '''Body types:''' body type '''0''' (the default) uses your own '''Minecraft skin''', and there are extra body types for each gender. With your own skin, the '''skin pixel editor''' lets you mark your eyes and hair so your transformations can recolor them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration ==
</translate>
<translate>
Zenkai and Limitless Power are tuned in the <code>saiyan</code> section of <code>racialSkills</code> in <code>general-server.json</code> (level gate, cooldown, knockout, boost sizes, permanent boosts and the Power Release bonus). False Super Saiyan has its own <code>falseSuperSaiyan</code> section, where it can also be limited to Saiyans whose Zenkai is spent. The Super Saiyan God Ritual is tuned in <code>superSaiyanGodRitual</code>. The Super Forms TP ladder is in <code>races/saiyan/character.json</code>, and each form's values are in its form file.
</translate>
